Qualità, tradizione, innovazione e orientamento al cliente sono i pilastri principali dell'azienda. Il focus delle attività è l'importazione di marchi automobilistici, la gestione di officine, la logistica di pezzi di ricambio e accessori e la fornitura di servizi finanziari. descriptionByLocale.en:
What you should know about us The Emil Frey Group is not only a Swiss family company with 100 years of experience, but also one of the leading companies in the automotive industry. Quality, tradition, innovation and customer orientation are the main pillars of the company. The focus of the activities is on the import of car brands, the operation of garages, the logistics of spare and accessories as well as the provision of financial services. The Emil Frey Baden in Oberrohrdorf offers a touch of British Cars, as an exclusive service partner for Jaguar and Land Rover. Your tasks
• They actively support our sales team in the success-oriented sale of certified Jaguar and Land Rover brands. From the first contact, accompany and advise our customers on vehicle selection as well as on financing and insurance options
• They support vehicle deliveries and contribute to a high level of customer satisfaction and sustainable customer support. Building and maintaining customer relationships and acquiring new customers are gradually part of your area of responsibility. They help with the maintenance and management of the car park and ensure an attractive vehicle presentation
• Assistance at events and exhibitions as well as close cooperation with our departments (workshop, spare parts warehouse and customer service) are also part of your area of responsibility
• Support of the sales manager in administrative work
• Analysis and evaluation of offers on Autoscout24 and Carmarket
• You will continue to develop your profile through targeted training and practical support as an independent sales consultant
• You are interested in sales and want to develop in car sales – First sales experience is beneficial, but not mandatory
• Your customer- and service-oriented personality as well as your communicative nature set you apart
• They have a commercial flair and enjoy dealing with people
• A high level of self-motivation, willingness to learn and enthusiasm for cars bring you with you
• You are interested in new technologies, trends and digital tools
• You work independently, responsibly and integrate well into a motivated team
• Stylistic German in words and writing, other foreign languages are an advantage
• You are in possession of the driving license category B What we offer you You will find with us a new challenge with exciting tasks and much more:
• Numerous discounts (new and used cars, service work and spare parts, vehicle and health insurance, fuel cards, hotels and much more)
• An own, attractive pension fund as an independent pension institution
• A long-term company perspective
• Individual training and development opportunities
• At least 25 days of holidays
• Great loyal team, large customer base for many years
• Modern working conditions
• A leadership culture with confidence and promotion
• 2 premium brands that inspire and challenge
• Long-term development opportunities How to contact us Vanessa Aminger, Regional HR Manager is looking forward to the complete application (e.g. CV, employment certificates, etc.) via the link "Apply now!". For reasons of better legibility, the simultaneous use of the language forms male, female and diverse (m/f/d) is omitted. Female and other gender identities are explicitly included. Diversity also means for us that people work together in teams that achieve the best possible results through their uniqueness and diversity. We believe that a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture enable us to realize our full potential.

• Assistance lors d'événements et de salons ainsi qu'une coopération étroite avec nos départements (atelier, entrepôt de pièces de rechange et service client) font également partie de votre domaine de responsabilité

• Vous avez un sens commercial et aimez traiter avec personnes
• Vous avez un haut niveau de motivation personnelle, une volonté d'apprendre et un enthousiasme pour les automobiles
• Vous êtes intéressé par les nouvelles technologies, les tendances et les outils de travail numériques
• Vous travaillez de manière indépendante, responsable et vous vous intégrez bien dans une équipe motivée
• Un allemand parlé et écrit élégant, d'autres langues étrangères sont un avantage
• Vous avez un permis de conduire de catégorie B Ce que nous vous proposons Vous en trouverez un nouveau chez nous Défiez avec des tâches passionnantes et bien plus encore :
• De nombreuses réductions (voitures neuves et d'occasion, travaux d'entretien et pièces de rechange, assurance automobile et maladie, cartes carburant, hôtels et bien plus)
• Notre propre caisse de pension attrayante en tant que caisse de pension indépendante
• Une perspective d'entreprise à long terme
• Des opportunités de formation et de développement individuelles
• Au moins 25 jours de vacances
• Une équipe formidable et fidèle, une large clientèle de longue date
• Des conditions de travail modernes
• Une culture de gestion avec confiance et soutien
